```{r}
fit_seed <- 999

build_curve_panel <- function(yield_list, curves) {
  out <- data.frame(time = yield_list[[1]]$time)

  for (curve_name in curves) {
    curve_df <- yield_list[[curve_name]][, -1, drop = FALSE]
    colnames(curve_df) <- paste0(curve_name, ".", sub("^X", "", colnames(curve_df)))
    out <- cbind(out, curve_df)
  }

  out
}

eval_in_sample_fit <- function(fit_obj, observed_yields, curves, mat_str) {
  actual_curve <- build_curve_panel(observed_yields, curves)
  fitted_curve <- fit_obj$curve

  common_cols <- setdiff(intersect(colnames(actual_curve), colnames(fitted_curve)), "time")
  actual_mat <- as.matrix(actual_curve[, common_cols])
  fitted_mat <- as.matrix(fitted_curve[, common_cols])
  resid_mat <- fitted_mat - actual_mat

  overall <- tibble::tibble(
    rows = nrow(actual_mat),
    series = ncol(actual_mat),
    mse = mean(resid_mat^2, na.rm = TRUE),
    rmse = sqrt(mean(resid_mat^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    mae = mean(abs(resid_mat), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_bias = mean(resid_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_abs_err = max(abs(resid_mat), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  curve_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(curves, function(curve_name) {
    cols <- grep(paste0("^", curve_name, "\\."), common_cols, value = TRUE)
    r <- as.matrix(fitted_curve[, cols] - actual_curve[, cols])

    tibble::tibble(
      curve = curve_name,
      mse = mean(r^2, na.rm = TRUE),
      rmse = sqrt(mean(r^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      mae = mean(abs(r), na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_bias = mean(r, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_abs_err = max(abs(r), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(rmse))

  tenor_levels <- sub("^.*\\.", "", common_cols)
  tenor_order <- sub("^X", "", mat_str)

  tenor_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(tenor_order, function(mat_name) {
    cols <- common_cols[tenor_levels == mat_name]
    r <- as.matrix(fitted_curve[, cols] - actual_curve[, cols])

    tibble::tibble(
      tenor = mat_name,
      mse = mean(r^2, na.rm = TRUE),
      rmse = sqrt(mean(r^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      mae = mean(abs(r), na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_bias = mean(r, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_abs_err = max(abs(r), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  })

  list(overall = overall, curve = curve_summary, tenor = tenor_summary)
}

print_fit_diagnostics <- function(diag_obj, label) {
  round_tbl <- function(tbl, id_cols) {
    out <- tbl
    num_cols <- setdiff(colnames(out), id_cols)
    out[num_cols] <- lapply(out[num_cols], round, digits = 6)
    out
  }

  cat(label, "\n")
  print(round_tbl(diag_obj$overall, character(0)))
  cat("\nCurve RMSE ranking\n")
  print(round_tbl(diag_obj$curve, "curve"))
  cat("\nTenor RMSE ranking\n")
  print(round_tbl(diag_obj$tenor, "tenor"))
}

compare_covreg_covariances <- function(cc_fit, agg = c("mean", "median")) {
  agg <- match.arg(agg)

  if (is.null(cc_fit$W) || is.null(cc_fit$sigma_JT$jSigma)) {
    stop("cc_fit must contain both W and sigma_JT$jSigma. Refit with the updated mc_fit_end().")
  }

  aggregate_sigma <- function(sigma_list) {
    sigma_array <- simplify2array(sigma_list)

    if (agg == "mean") {
      apply(sigma_array, c(1, 2), mean)
    } else {
      apply(sigma_array, c(1, 2), median)
    }
  }

  tenor_names <- intersect(names(cc_fit$W), names(cc_fit$sigma_JT$jSigma))

  empirical <- setNames(lapply(tenor_names, function(mat_name) {
    stats::cov(as.matrix(cc_fit$W[[mat_name]]), use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  }), tenor_names)

  estimated <- setNames(lapply(tenor_names, function(mat_name) {
    aggregate_sigma(cc_fit$sigma_JT$jSigma[[mat_name]])
  }), tenor_names)

  deltas <- setNames(lapply(tenor_names, function(mat_name) {
    estimated[[mat_name]] - empirical[[mat_name]]
  }), tenor_names)

  summary <- purrr::map_dfr(tenor_names, function(mat_name) {
    emp_cov <- empirical[[mat_name]]
    est_cov <- estimated[[mat_name]]
    delta_cov <- deltas[[mat_name]]
    off_diag <- row(emp_cov) != col(emp_cov)

    tibble::tibble(
      tenor = mat_name,
      empirical_trace = sum(diag(emp_cov)),
      estimated_trace = sum(diag(est_cov)),
      frob_error = norm(delta_cov, type = "F"),
      mse = mean(delta_cov^2),
      diag_mae = mean(abs(diag(delta_cov))),
      offdiag_mae = mean(abs(delta_cov[off_diag])),
      emp_offdiag_mean = mean(emp_cov[off_diag]),
      est_offdiag_mean = mean(est_cov[off_diag])
    )
  }) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(maturity = mats[match(tenor, mat_str)]) %>%
    dplyr::select(maturity, tenor, dplyr::everything()) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(maturity)

  list(summary = summary, empirical = empirical, estimated = estimated, delta = deltas)
}

print_covariance_comparison <- function(cov_obj, label) {
  out <- cov_obj$summary
  num_cols <- setdiff(colnames(out), c("maturity", "tenor"))
  out[num_cols] <- lapply(out[num_cols], round, digits = 6)

  cat(label, "\n")
  print(out)
}

rebuild_check_phi_path <- function(fit_obj, observed_yields, curves, mats, lambdas, cutoffs) {
  mat_str_local <- sapply(mats, numeric_to_matname)
  mds <- as.vector(t(outer(curves, mat_str_local, paste, sep = ".")))

  curve_lambdas <- vapply(observed_yields, function(curve_df) {
    lambda_grid_search(lambdas, curve_df, mats)
  }, numeric(1))

  bl_yields <- transpose(setNames(lapply(seq_along(observed_yields), function(i) {
    bl_single_curve(curve_lambdas[i], observed_yields[[i]], cutoffs, mats)
  }), curves))

  Y <- vecY(observed_yields, curves, mats)
  P <- bln_build_P(curves, mats)
  sqrt_inv_sigma_t <- sqrt_inv_build(fit_obj$sigma_JT$tSigma)$inverse

  phi_hat <- bln_phi_hat(bl_yields$phi, mds)
  phib <- bln_phi_BT(phi_hat, P, sqrt_inv_sigma_t)
  phic <- bln_phi_CT(phib, P)

  list(
    time = as.Date(Y$time),
    check_phi = cf_phi_cut(phic, curves, mats)
  )
}

safe_rcond <- function(mat) {
  tryCatch(rcond(mat), error = function(e) NA_real_)
}

summarize_sigma_path <- function(fit_obj, label) {
  purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(fit_obj$sigma_JT$tSigma), function(i) {
    sigma_t <- as.matrix(fit_obj$sigma_JT$tSigma[[i]])
    eig <- eigen((sigma_t + t(sigma_t)) / 2, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values
    min_eig <- min(eig)
    max_eig <- max(eig)

    tibble::tibble(
      specification = label,
      time = as.Date(fit_obj$curve$time[i]),
      sigma_trace = sum(diag(sigma_t)),
      sigma_min_eig = min_eig,
      sigma_max_eig = max_eig,
      sigma_cond = max_eig / max(min_eig, 1e-10)
    )
  })
}

summarize_check_phi_path <- function(check_phi_obj, time_index, curves, label) {
  purrr::map_dfr(curves, function(curve_name) {
    purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(time_index), function(i) {
      phi_t <- check_phi_obj[[curve_name]][[i]]
      gram_t <- crossprod(phi_t)
      eig <- eigen((gram_t + t(gram_t)) / 2, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values
      phi_rcond <- safe_rcond(gram_t)

      tibble::tibble(
        specification = label,
        time = as.Date(time_index[i]),
        curve = curve_name,
        phi_min_eig = min(eig),
        phi_max_eig = max(eig),
        phi_rcond = phi_rcond,
        phi_cond = ifelse(is.na(phi_rcond) || phi_rcond <= 0, Inf, 1 / phi_rcond)
      )
    })
  })
}

build_fit_error_panel <- function(fit_obj, observed_yields, curves) {
  actual_curve <- build_curve_panel(observed_yields, curves)
  fitted_curve <- fit_obj$curve

  common_cols <- setdiff(intersect(colnames(actual_curve), colnames(fitted_curve)), "time")

  actual_long <- tibble::as_tibble(actual_curve[, c("time", common_cols)]) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(time = as.Date(time)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-time, names_to = "series", values_to = "actual")

  fitted_long <- tibble::as_tibble(fitted_curve[, c("time", common_cols)]) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(time = as.Date(time)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-time, names_to = "series", values_to = "fitted")

  dplyr::left_join(actual_long, fitted_long, by = c("time", "series")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      curve = sub("\\..*$", "", series),
      tenor = sub("^.*\\.", "", series),
      error = fitted - actual,
      abs_error = abs(error)
    )
}

build_alignment_diagnostics <- function(fit_obj, observed_yields, curves, mats, lambdas, cutoffs, label) {
  check_phi_state <- rebuild_check_phi_path(
    fit_obj = fit_obj,
    observed_yields = observed_yields,
    curves = curves,
    mats = mats,
    lambdas = lambdas,
    cutoffs = cutoffs
  )

  sigma_path <- summarize_sigma_path(fit_obj, label)
  phi_path <- summarize_check_phi_path(check_phi_state$check_phi, check_phi_state$time, curves, label)

  error_panel <- build_fit_error_panel(fit_obj, observed_yields, curves) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(specification = label)

  worst_by_day <- error_panel %>%
    dplyr::group_by(specification, time) %>%
    dplyr::slice_max(abs_error, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::left_join(sigma_path, by = c("specification", "time")) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(phi_path, by = c("specification", "time", "curve")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sigma_trace_pct = dplyr::percent_rank(sigma_trace),
      sigma_min_eig_pct_low = dplyr::percent_rank(-sigma_min_eig),
      phi_rcond_pct_low = dplyr::percent_rank(-phi_rcond),
      phi_cond_pct = dplyr::percent_rank(phi_cond),
      phi_rcond_floor = pmax(phi_rcond, 1e-12, na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  list(
    sigma_path = sigma_path,
    phi_path = phi_path,
    error_panel = error_panel,
    worst_by_day = worst_by_day
  )
}

build_baseline_ns_curve <- function(observed_yields, curves, mats, lambdas, cutoffs) {
  mat_str_local <- paste0("X", sapply(mats, numeric_to_matname))

  curve_lambdas <- vapply(observed_yields, function(curve_df) {
    lambda_grid_search(lambdas, curve_df, mats)
  }, numeric(1))

  bl_yields <- transpose(setNames(lapply(seq_along(observed_yields), function(i) {
    bl_single_curve(curve_lambdas[i], observed_yields[[i]], cutoffs, mats)
  }), curves))

  baseline_list <- setNames(lapply(curves, function(curve_name) {
    out <- data.frame(time = observed_yields[[curve_name]]$time, as.data.frame(bl_yields$nsfit[[curve_name]]$NSfit))
    colnames(out) <- c("time", mat_str_local)
    out
  }), curves)

  build_curve_panel(baseline_list, curves)
}

rebuild_curve_with_sigma <- function(fit_obj, observed_yields, curves, mats, lambdas, cutoffs, sigma_path) {
  mat_str_local <- sapply(mats, numeric_to_matname)
  mds <- as.vector(t(outer(curves, mat_str_local, paste, sep = ".")))

  curve_lambdas <- vapply(observed_yields, function(curve_df) {
    lambda_grid_search(lambdas, curve_df, mats)
  }, numeric(1))

  bl_yields <- transpose(setNames(lapply(seq_along(observed_yields), function(i) {
    bl_single_curve(curve_lambdas[i], observed_yields[[i]], cutoffs, mats)
  }), curves))

  Y <- vecY(observed_yields, curves, mats)
  P <- bln_build_P(curves, mats)
  pY <- PY_full(Y$tY, P)

  sqrt_sigma_state <- sqrt_inv_build(sigma_path)
  sqrt_sigma_t <- sqrt_sigma_state$sqrt
  sqrt_inv_sigma_t <- sqrt_sigma_state$inverse

  phi_hat <- bln_phi_hat(bl_yields$phi, mds)
  yb <- bln_YB(pY$py, sqrt_inv_sigma_t)
  phib <- bln_phi_BT(phi_hat, P, sqrt_inv_sigma_t)
  phic <- bln_phi_CT(phib, P)
  yc <- PY_full(yb, t(P))

  ycut <- cf_curve_cut(yc$py, curves, mats)
  phicut <- cf_phi_cut(phic, curves, mats)
  normalized <- bln_normalized_fit(ycut, phicut, curves, mats)

  ycut_norm <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(ycut[[1]])), function(i) {
    y_i <- unlist(lapply(curves, function(curve_name) {
      as.numeric(ycut[[curve_name]][i, ])
    }))
    sqrt(mean(y_i^2))
  }, numeric(1))

  projection_rmse <- sqrt(mean(unlist(lapply(curves, function(curve_name) {
    (as.matrix(normalized$n_yield[[curve_name]]) - as.matrix(ycut[[curve_name]]))^2
  }))))

  list(
    curve = blce_rescale_yield(
      normalized = normalized$n_yield,
      sqrt_sigma_t = sqrt_sigma_t,
      P = P,
      ptype = "curve",
      time = Y$time,
      curves = curves,
      mats = mats
    ),
    projection_rmse = projection_rmse,
    mean_ycut_norm = mean(ycut_norm)
  )
}

sigma_path_variants <- function(fit_obj) {
  sigma_tv <- lapply(fit_obj$sigma_JT$tSigma, as.matrix)
  sigma_array <- simplify2array(sigma_tv)
  sigma_mean <- apply(sigma_array, c(1, 2), mean)

  list(
    full_sigma = sigma_tv,
    static_mean_sigma = rep(list(sigma_mean), length(sigma_tv)),
    diag_only_sigma = lapply(sigma_tv, function(sigma_t) diag(diag(sigma_t)))
  )
}

summarize_sigma_rebuilds <- function(fit_obj, observed_yields, curves, mats, lambdas, cutoffs) {
  baseline_curve <- build_baseline_ns_curve(
    observed_yields = observed_yields,
    curves = curves,
    mats = mats,
    lambdas = lambdas,
    cutoffs = cutoffs
  )

  baseline_diag <- eval_in_sample_fit(
    fit_obj = list(curve = baseline_curve),
    observed_yields = observed_yields,
    curves = curves,
    mat_str = mat_str
  )

  sigma_variant_tbl <- purrr::imap_dfr(
    sigma_path_variants(fit_obj),
    function(sigma_path, sigma_variant) {
      rebuilt <- rebuild_curve_with_sigma(
        fit_obj = fit_obj,
        observed_yields = observed_yields,
        curves = curves,
        mats = mats,
        lambdas = lambdas,
        cutoffs = cutoffs,
        sigma_path = sigma_path
      )

      diag_obj <- eval_in_sample_fit(
        fit_obj = list(curve = rebuilt$curve),
        observed_yields = observed_yields,
        curves = curves,
        mat_str = mat_str
      )

      tibble::tibble(
        sigma_variant = sigma_variant,
        rmse = diag_obj$overall$rmse,
        mae = diag_obj$overall$mae,
        max_abs_err = diag_obj$overall$max_abs_err,
        projection_rmse = rebuilt$projection_rmse,
        mean_ycut_norm = rebuilt$mean_ycut_norm
      )
    }
  )

  dplyr::bind_rows(
    tibble::tibble(
      sigma_variant = "baseline_ns",
      rmse = baseline_diag$overall$rmse,
      mae = baseline_diag$overall$mae,
      max_abs_err = baseline_diag$overall$max_abs_err,
      projection_rmse = 0,
      mean_ycut_norm = NA_real_
    ),
    sigma_variant_tbl
  )
}

summarize_ecm_ranks <- function(fit_obj) {
  tibble::tibble(
    pair = names(fit_obj$curveECM),
    rank = vapply(fit_obj$curveECM, function(ecm_obj) ecm_obj$rank, numeric(1))
  )
}

summarize_sigma_block_coupling <- function(fit_obj, agg = c("mean", "median")) {
  agg <- match.arg(agg)

  aggregate_sigma <- function(sigma_list) {
    sigma_array <- simplify2array(sigma_list)

    if (agg == "mean") {
      apply(sigma_array, c(1, 2), mean)
    } else {
      apply(sigma_array, c(1, 2), median)
    }
  }

  purrr::map_dfr(names(fit_obj$sigma_JT$jSigma), function(tenor_name) {
    sigma_t <- aggregate_sigma(fit_obj$sigma_JT$jSigma[[tenor_name]])
    sigma_offdiag <- sigma_t
    diag(sigma_offdiag) <- 0

    tibble::tibble(
      maturity = mats[match(tenor_name, mat_str)],
      tenor = tenor_name,
      diag_mean = mean(diag(sigma_t)),
      offdiag_abs_mean = mean(abs(sigma_offdiag[row(sigma_offdiag) != col(sigma_offdiag)])),
      offdiag_frob_share = norm(sigma_offdiag, type = "F") / norm(sigma_t, type = "F")
    )
  }) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(maturity)
}
```

## endogenous cross-curve estimation: 2010 window
yields_2010 <- annual_yields[["2010"]]

set.seed(fit_seed)
cc_fit_2010 <- mc_fit_end(
  yields = yields_2010,
  lambdas = lambdas,
  cutoffs = c(4, 8),
  reference = "usa",
  curves = curves,
  mats = mats,
  X_trunc = TRUE,
  Xt_smooth = FALSE ,
  smoother = "hp",
  COV_TEST = FALSE, 
  CR_S0_shrink_diag=0.5
)

plot(cc_fit_2010$curve$jpn.01Y, type = 'l', ylim=c(-4,4))
lines(yields$jpn$X01Y, col = 'blue')
```

  mats = mats,

  observed_yields = yields_2010,
  curves = curves,
  mats = mats,
  lambdas = lambdas,

)

sigma_path_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  aligndiag_2010_smooth$sigma_path,
  aligndiag_2010_nosmooth$sigma_path
)

sigma_path_long <- sigma_path_df %>%
  dplyr::select(specification, time, sigma_trace, sigma_min_eig, sigma_cond) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(sigma_trace, sigma_min_eig, sigma_cond),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  )

ggplot(sigma_path_long, aes(x = time, y = value, color = specification)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    title = expression("Time path diagnostics for " * Sigma[t]),
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    color = "Specification"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
worst_by_day_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  aligndiag_2010_smooth$worst_by_day,
  aligndiag_2010_nosmooth$worst_by_day
)

alignment_rank_corr <- worst_by_day_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(specification) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    spearman_abs_err_sigma_trace = cor(abs_error, sigma_trace, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
    spearman_abs_err_sigma_min_eig = cor(abs_error, sigma_min_eig, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
    spearman_abs_err_phi_rcond = cor(abs_error, phi_rcond, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
    spearman_abs_err_phi_cond = cor(abs_error, phi_cond, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
  )

alignment_rank_corr

worst_by_day_df %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs_error)) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    specification, time, curve, tenor, actual, fitted, error, abs_error,
    sigma_trace, sigma_min_eig, sigma_cond,
    phi_min_eig, phi_rcond, phi_cond,
    sigma_trace_pct, sigma_min_eig_pct_low, phi_rcond_pct_low, phi_cond_pct
  ) %>%
  head(15)
```

```{r}
ggplot(worst_by_day_df, aes(x = sigma_trace, y = abs_error, color = specification)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, method = "loess", span = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~specification, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "Worst daily fitted yield error vs Sigma_t trace",
    x = expression("trace(" * Sigma[t] * ")"),
    y = "Worst absolute yield error"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(worst_by_day_df, aes(x = sigma_min_eig, y = abs_error, color = specification)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, method = "loess", span = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~specification, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "Worst daily fitted yield error vs minimum eigenvalue of Sigma_t",
    x = expression("min eig(" * Sigma[t] * ")"),
    y = "Worst absolute yield error"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(worst_by_day_df, aes(x = phi_rcond_floor, y = abs_error, color = specification)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, method = "loess", span = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~specification, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Worst daily fitted yield error vs reciprocal condition of check_phi_t",
    x = "rcond(crossprod(check_phi_t))",
    y = "Worst absolute yield error"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
